# one-source-retired.txt -- the copies of nova-tools code that are retired and must
# not come back (the rule in internal/ci/one_source_retired_test.go,
# TestNoRetiredOneSourceCopyReturns).
#
# The roadmap, the s-expression reader and the Limits that bounds it have one
# source: nova-tools pkg/roadmap and pkg/sexp (nova-tools#5746; the 10 MiB bound
# of nova-tools#5811 landed twice because Limits was defined in both repos).
# nova-sprint imports them; it carries no copy.
#
# One row per retired path: `<path><TAB><what replaced it>`. A listed path that
# exists in the module is red. The same test refuses any Go type in the module
# named Limits with the fields MaxBytes, MaxDepth and MaxNodes: that is the copy
# returning under another path. Value literals of sexp.Limits are uses, not
# copies, and stay.

internal/roadmapdoc	github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/pkg/roadmap
internal/worklang	github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/pkg/sexp
tools/roadmap	github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/tools/roadmap (go run through the go.mod tool directive: make roadmap)
